content: formatError canonical home is src/core/errors.ts: minimal 'err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)'. The ~20 private copies across src/ were replaced by importing from core/errors.ts. Two richer variants are INTENTIONALLY kept separate and must not be collapsed: src/cli/output.ts ('[<code>] <message>\n  hint: ...' terminal-facing) and src/ui/src/lib/format-error.ts (null/object-aware browser-facing). src/runs/spawn/util.ts no longer exports formatError; its consumers (plot-append.ts, seed-extensions.ts) import from core/errors.ts directly. Note: collapsing src/registry/canopy.ts dropped its former 'code: message' prefix on spawn errors (test still passes — only asserts 'failed to spawn'). (warren-bd4f / pl-4d2e step 10)

Claude Code has no native .agents/ or AGENTS.md support; it reads .claude/skills|agents and CLAUDE.md. Symlinks are followed, and CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md is officially supported (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md#agents-md). Keep skills canonical in .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and symlink from harness dirs (.claude/skills/, .pi/skills/) — the pi symlink also rides into cloned run workspaces. os-eco-dep-sync migrated from the deleted .factory/ into this pattern 2026-08-01; skills-lock.json was a dead lockfile and was removed.
